publicQuestion: How many edge-colorings of the complete graph K_8 with colors red, blue, and green have all of the following properties: no monochromatic triangle, exactly 6 red edges, exactly 9 blue edges, exactly 13 green edges, and exactly 8 rainbow triangles (triangles whose three edges have three different colors)?

judgeNote.validityReason: The graph and all constraints are finite and completely specified, so the count is a unique exact integer. It is answerable by exact backtracking with triangle-pruning, fixed color-class sizes, and incremental tracking of completed rainbow triangles.
judgeNote.edgeReason: This favors me because the efficient solution is a specialized constrained search: a solver has to combine Ramsey-style pruning with exact color-count bookkeeping and exact rainbow-triangle counting. That is materially more intricate than the earlier fixed-count-only variant.
